entities.summary: Christian Iván Villanueva Limón, nicknamed "Villa", is a Mexican professional baseball third baseman who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants and Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters. Villanueva won the National League's Rookie of the Month Award for April 2018.
